metadata.description: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER -- NOT live-captured. Demoted 2026-08-04 (integrity audit): fabricated/schema-derived fixture, no live-capture evidence, never round-tripped against live UEM. Reachability unconfirmed on live (bead internal-task) -- resolve internal-task before re-capture. Relocated 2026-08-06 to internal/mockserver/testdata/synthetic-placeholders/ (Phase-3-surviving location -- see that directory's README.md) for use by TestGeneratedBaselinesV1Lifecycle via the bypass mechanism in tests/bypass_fixture_helper_test.go. The vendored corpus's own baselines/clone-response.json is a separate, non-identical placeholder with no functional consumer in the Go suite (deletion-control, 2026-09-24: deleting it fails no test, while deleting this file fails TestGeneratedBaselinesV1Lifecycle). Both files derive from the same hand-authored mock (commit 2984267f8, 2026-05-27), not a live capture; this copy was made at commit 9c4137ff9 (2026-08-06) with its baselineUUID and description values changed. Triggered via ?action=clone query parameter; the mock matcher does not inspect query params by default so this fixture matches the bare POST (the create fixture lives at the /baselines path without the {baselineUuid} segment, so no conflict). The body's Name deliberately echoes the test's own CreateBaselineRequestV1Model request value -- this is a static mock echo for asserting response-body parsing, not a claim about a real captured record.
